answer: Names are free, custody is not. Issue a fixed set of relics, one per active role, and let an identity act only while it holds one. To keep a relic, its holder must publicly tend it, add a dated improvement, and pass it to a stranger chosen by lot, whose mirror copy of its history must match before the handover counts. Behind the velvet queue, extra masks wait for the same few relics: a farm gains no new slots by multiplying names, only longer waits and more handovers to fake, so honest holders circulate while clones stall.
